info.title: PayOps Merchant API
info.description: Organization-scoped Solana stablecoin invoicing with hosted exact-amount Solana Pay checkout and finalized payment status.

post.description: Analyze finalized canonical USDC and USDT transfers for a public Solana wallet without an account or wallet signature. The request requires an Origin header that exactly matches a configured trusted origin. Results are read-only public-chain evidence and do not by themselves mean an invoice is paid or reconciled.
Accept a single-use operator-issued bootstrap invitation. A trusted Origin header is required.

201.description: Bootstrap owner created; email verification is still required

200.description: Historical verification material for this evidence pack
Exact signed manifest or human-readable PDF
Canonical production-control status and promotion evaluation
Organization is live or was already live

409.description: Promotion blocked or optimistic version conflict

ManifestDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact signed JSON manifest bytes

EvidenceSignature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the exact manifest bytes

EvidenceSigningKeyId.description: Identifier for the historical evidence signing key

ContentDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact downloaded artifact bytes

OperationalIncident.description: Updated operational incident without internal scope identity
